procedure_steps.instruction: Place 5 mL aniline in a 100 mL round-bottom flask; add 5 mL acetic anhydride and 5 mL glacial acetic acid.
procedure_steps.observation: This selects the anhydride method, not the acetyl-chloride alternative.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
